Two angles are called supplementary if their sum is:
True or False: Vertically opposite angles are always equal.
questions.explanation: Vertically opposite angles formed by two intersecting lines are always equal

questions.question: Two adjacent angles that together form a straight line are called:
questions.explanation: A linear pair of angles are adjacent and their sum is 180°

questions.question: Two lines in a plane that never meet, however far extended, are called:
questions.explanation: Parallel lines lie in the same plane and never intersect

questions.question: Two lines that intersect each other at 90° are called:
questions.explanation: Perpendicular lines meet at a right angle (90°)

questions.question: A line that intersects two or more lines at distinct points is called:
questions.explanation: A transversal is a line that cuts two or more lines at different points

questions.question: True or False: Corresponding angles formed by a transversal with two parallel lines are equal.
options: Only if the transversal is perpendicular
questions.explanation: Corresponding angles are equal when the lines cut by the transversal are parallel

questions.question: When a transversal cuts two parallel lines, the pair of alternate interior angles are:
questions.explanation: Alternate interior angles are equal when the lines are parallel

questions.question: Two lines cut by a transversal are parallel if the co-interior (allied) angles are:
questions.explanation: Lines are parallel when co-interior angles add up to 180°
